API ReferenceZIdentity APIUsersUsers Ops Get
Users Ops Get
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users/:id

Retrieves detailed information about a specific user using the provided user ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the user to retrieve.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and the user details are returned.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier ID of the user.

source
SourceType (string)
REQUIRED

The source type where the user was created.

Possible values: [UI, API, SCIM, JIT]

idp
object
]
